resolved_defect.title: WBS Hierarchy Collision & Code Hijacking
resolved_defect.description: Candidate prompt assigned WBS code 5.4.1 to cochem-sdp-manager to decompose the Risk Register (RSK-CHUNK17-01 to 06), colliding with ratified Task 5.4.1 (Sequential Persona Dispatch owned by 0rchestrator).
resolved_defect.resolution: Resolved by re-affirming Task 5.4.1 exclusively to 0rchestrator for Sequential Persona Dispatch & Stage Machine Handshake, and codifying the PMBOK/SWEBOK risk decomposition under Task 5.R.1 (assigned to cochem-sdp-manager) and Task 5.R.2 (Architectural Defenses). cochem-sdp-manager is confirmed as execution agent for governance specifications under strict negative coding prohibitions.

raci_enforcement.cochem_sdp_manager: Governance, PMBOK 100% rule, acceptance criteria (Task 5.R.1, 5.R.2, 5.4.4). Strict negative prohibition against modifying src/ or tests/.
raci_enforcement.0rchestrator: Single accountable agent for Task 5.4.1 Sequential Persona Dispatch & Stage Machine Handshake.
raci_enforcement.cochem_coder: Exclusive code implementation authority in src/ and ci_tools/.
raci_enforcement.cochem_tester: Exclusive physical test execution and PID telemetry capture.
